text: みつかっちゃったわね！

structure.jp: みつかっちゃったわね！
structure.en: I've gone and been found, haven't I!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret; ちゃった is its shortened spoken past form. みつかっちゃった = 'I've gone and been found'.

patterns.name: 〜わね
patterns.explanation: わ gives a soft feminine tone and ね asks the listener to agree. みつかっちゃったわね = 'I've been found, haven't I'.
